title: Extract Images from Word – Save All DOCX Pictures in a ZIP
description: Save every picture in a Word document at its original quality and format, JPG, PNG, GIF and more, in one ZIP, in your browser. Free, no upload.
heading: Extract images from Word
subtitle: Save every picture in a Word document at its original quality, all in one ZIP; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Extract images from a DOCX file without opening Word: every picture stored in the document is saved as a file of its own, in its original format (JPG, PNG, GIF, EMF and others) and at its original quality, because nothing is re-compressed. They come in one ZIP. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your document is read by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Original quality
features.text: Pictures are saved exactly as they are stored; nothing is re-compressed.

features.title: All at once
features.text: Every picture in the document comes in one ZIP.

stepsTitle: How to extract images from a Word document

steps.title: Choose your document
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .docx file on the page.

steps.title: Check the pictures
steps.text: See the pictures found in the document.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the ZIP with every picture.

handles: Pictures: every picture stored in the document.
Formats: kept as stored, such as JPG, PNG, GIF and EMF.
limits: Pictures linked from the web are not stored in the file, so they can't be extracted.
Charts and SmartArt are drawings, not pictures, so they are not saved as image files.
Old .doc files can't be read; save them as .docx first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I extract images from a Word document?
faq.answer: A Word document keeps each picture as a separate file inside it, so the pictures can be saved at their original quality; in Word you can also save them one at a time from the picture's right-click menu. On this page, choose the .docx and download every picture in one ZIP, read in your browser.

faq.question: Are the pictures compressed?
faq.answer: No. Each picture is saved exactly as it is stored in the document, in its original format and quality.

faq.question: Why is a picture missing?
faq.answer: Pictures linked from the web are not stored in the file, so there is nothing to extract. Charts and SmartArt are drawings, not pictures, and are not saved either.

faq.question: Which formats come out?
faq.answer: The ones stored in the document: usually JPG and PNG, sometimes GIF or EMF.

faq.question: Can I see the document first?
faq.answer: Yes. Open it in the Word viewer to see where each picture sits.
